definitions.gloss: the forefront; the front line (of a field)
definitions.explanation: The leading, most active position in a field of work. Originally the front line in war, now mostly figurative.

examples.japanese: {第一線|だいいっせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: To be active at the forefront.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧{第一線|だいいっせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{退|しりぞ}いた→退く：20858_shirizoku⟧。
examples.english: He retired from the front line last year.

examples.japanese: {七十歳|ななじゅっさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{第一線|だいいっせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧{続|つづ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Even past seventy, she remains at the forefront of research.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {第一線|だいいっせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧: to be active at the top of one's field
- {第一線|だいいっせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{退|しりぞ}く→退く：20858_shirizoku⟧: to step back from active work
- {第一線|だいいっせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand at the forefront
- {第一線|だいいっせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧: a leading researcher

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最前線|さいぜんせん}→最前線：13057_saizensen⟧: the very front line; more often literal (battle, disaster sites) or the cutting edge
- ⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧: the front (in war); also a weather front
